normalization.book: All rows grouped by exact local_timestamp; pre-snapshot deltas ignored; snapshots reset state; zero amounts delete levels; chunks contain an exact starting checkpoint.
normalization.trades: Every trade retained in chunk assets; aggressor buy maps to ask and sell maps to bid.
normalization.liquidity: Aggregate resting bid and ask amount sampled every 5 seconds into 1 USDT bins; uint16 values use 100 units per BTC and clip at 655.35 BTC.

liquidity.normalization: log1p using the 99.5th percentile of non-zero sampled bins
